name: caas-gate
description: Lets your Claude.ai chat hand work to a Claude Code session already running on this PC, through a gate that opens only four tools.
long_description: CAAS (Chat-Agent Auto Session): talk to your everyday Claude.ai chat, a Claude Code session already running on this PC does the work, and the answer comes back to the same chat by itself. This extension is the gate between the chat and Claude Code. It starts `claude mcp serve` and lets the chat use only ListAgents, SendMessage (only to sessions whose name matches the pattern below), and Read / Glob (only inside the tray folder). Everything else is refused. Install the session side with `/plugin marketplace add Rurimpa/caas` and `/plugin install caas@caas` in Claude Code, and the chat side with the caas-chat skill.

tools.name: ListAgents
tools.description: List the Claude Code sessions running on this PC

tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description: Send work to a running session (only names matching the allowed pattern)

tools.name: Read
tools.description: Read an answer file (only inside the tray folder)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: List answer files (only inside the tray folder)

tray_dir.title: Tray folder
tray_dir.description: Where sessions put answers for the chat. Created if missing. Tell the chat this path when it asks.

send_allow.title: Sessions the chat may message
send_allow.description: A pattern of session names. The default allows CAAS_agent_1, CAAS_agent_2, ... and hand-off sessions like CAAS_agent_1-2 (start one with: claude --name CAAS_agent_1).

claude_exe.title: Claude Code (claude.exe) - optional
claude_exe.description: Leave empty to find it automatically.
